name: Release Notes Drafter
description: Drafts user-facing release notes from merged PR or changelog source data.
tagline: Turns merged PRs and changelog entries into clear user-facing release notes.

ownedSettings.label: Release notes draft schedule
ownedSettings.description: Cron, model, prompt, and run parameters.

fields.label: Merged PR and changelog endpoints
fields.helpText: One HTTP(S) endpoint per line. Endpoints can be native APIs, internal exports, webhooks, or JSON/text snapshots.

fields.label: Bearer token env vars
fields.helpText: Comma-separated environment variable names. The first variable with a value is used as a Bearer token.

fields.label: Context notes
fields.placeholder: Audience: product users, not engineers. Group by Added, Improved, Fixed, and Internal only when relevant.
fields.helpText: Optional instructions, priorities, account names, or pasted context to include in every run.

fields.label: Publish report to Item Bus
fields.helpText: When enabled, each run publishes the report as a release.notes-draft item.

routes.label: Releases
routes.description: Drafts user-facing release notes from merged PR or changelog source data.
